name: ci-alert-escalation-bridge
why: Hourly cron (t/3912). 6h allows a few coalesced misses before alerting, same buffer class as the other hourly bridges.

name: data-compliance-alert-bridge
why: Delivers best-effort, not hourly (Orca Support, t/4053#3) -- missed fires coalesce. 12h matches the heartbeat-stale default used elsewhere in this codebase (CiAlertEscalationVerdict.ps1's HeartbeatStaleHours).

name: data-compliance-watchdog-reader
why: Hourly cron (t/4053 leg b). This is the exact reminder whose absence (never scheduled for 5 days post-merge) is the failure class t/4139 exists to catch.

name: shared-checkout-drift-check
why: Hourly cron, 1198+ runs observed -- the fleet's longest-running, highest-volume ops sweep. A gap here means the shared-checkout backstop is silently dead.

name: data-checkout-drift-check
why: Hourly cron (t/4005). Guards the ai-triad-data / ai-triad-sources shared checkouts the same way r/11 guards this repo's.

name: agents-md-overlay-budget-check
why: Daily cron (t/4329, t/4094 remainder). 30h allows one missed daily fire before alerting -- the overlay AGENTS.md size ratchet, covering the ~34 role/sub-role files a GitHub Actions checkout can't see.

name: deploy-identity-rbac-drift-check
why: Daily cron (t/4397). 30h allows one missed daily fire before alerting -- an unannounced disappearance of an out-of-band RBAC grant on the fleet deploy identity has no other signal.
